what_this_is: The one schedule/registry of the reaction loop: every stage (capture -> observation store -> change detection -> dependency index -> recheck -> state -> sign -> capsule -> land), the scheduled jobs that carry it, and every observed subject with the claim it checks, the surfaces it reads and the fields it compares (the dependency index: claim -> sources -> fields). Job ids are the ids of the estate job registry (fleet/automation/JOBS.json, deployed as ~/fleet/jobs_registry.json); job status is read live from the output-novelty reader (~/fleet/output_novelty.json), never typed here.
what_this_is_not: Not a grade, ranking or approval of anything. Stage status (LIVE / STAGED / MISSING) is derived each cycle from job evidence; this file only declares which jobs carry which stage.

cycle.grace_note: The novelty reader runs hourly (:47), so a job's newest output is known to within an hour. A stage is STALE when its newest output is older than stale_after_cycles x its period + grace_s.
